user.title: Set up HA Dev Tools
user.description:
Registers a `dev_tools` LLM API for Home Assistant's native `mcp_server` integration to serve. No configuration is needed here - tools stay disarmed until you run this on the Home Assistant host (via SSH or the Terminal add-on):

`date +%s > /config/.storage/ha_dev_tools.armed`

That arms it for up to 4 hours (extended by 30 minutes on each use, idle windows beyond 30 minutes expire it). Every tool call is also checked against the calling user's admin status - see the documentation link on this integration's page for why both gates exist.

abort.single_instance_allowed: HA Dev Tools is already configured. Only one instance is supported.

data_description.dry_run: When enabled, every write tool (write_automation, create/update/delete_helper, write_dashboard) is blocked - the tool call's own input is returned to the agent as a preview instead of being applied. Read-only tools and reload_domain/check_config are unaffected.
